finding: The old imu_between wait condition only checked the latest timestamp against the requested end. A sample beyond the window could end waiting despite missing samples within that window; no retry was made for such gaps.
causal_limit: The failed recording omits the poller latest timestamp and elapsed wait. It cannot distinguish SDK delay / wait expiry from an in-window history gap for this particular failure.
changes: Check requested head, tail and internal gaps using configured thresholds before returning.
Query only deficient intervals within existing wait_imu_s and at most 200 history requests; merge real valid SDK samples into sorted unique returned batch.
Serialize polling and recovery SDK access without holding the sample condition lock.
Preserve monotonic latest checks and existing 20 ms boundary / 50 ms internal gap protections.
Log latest_before_end vs history_gap, elapsed wait, latest timestamp offset and history query counts.

deployment.mode: GDK-only wheel replacement; existing dependencies and core native wheel retained

limitations: The SDK probe deliberately removed a known historical interval from its own cache; it was not a recurrence of the original failure.
Long-duration moving mapping is not validated by the short recovery probe. Actual missing sensor data still stops mapping.
